question: I’d like you to tell me about Otto’s older brother and such.
answer: He’s Olso Suwen.  He works as the representative of the Suwen Company. and although he’s young, he’s a fearless sort that wears a beard well.  He’s worried about Otto, but he understands the reasons for what’s happening, so he’s set it aside as a matter that will probably turn out alright.  Actually, it did turn out alright, so good eye, good eye.
